Messages.Author: Cartman
Messages.Body:
A plays Political Struggle on Prince B, and then sends him to torpor, so:
1)does B still remain a Prince, or he looses his title
2)A gains 2 votes, but is he considered a titled vampire?

I bleed for 1, my prey doesn't block but reduces the bleed:
can I play inferior Freak Drive?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Cartman wrote:
> A plays Political Struggle on Prince B, and then sends him to torpor, so:
> 1)does B still remain a Prince, or he looses his title

He remains a prince.

> 2)A gains 2 votes, but is he considered a titled vampire?

No.

> I bleed for 1, my prey doesn't block but reduces the bleed:
> can I play inferior Freak Drive?

Yes. It cares only if the action is successful (unblocked),
ot if the bleed (if it was a bleed action) succeeds (or if
the hunt succeeds, or if the referendum passes, etc.).
